resources.string: Pump integration for Omnipod Dash (the Bluetooth model with a blue needle cap).

Omnipod Dash on iPhone is new and has not been tested with a real pod yet. Check every pod activation, bolus and temp basal on the pod screen. While no pod runs, AAPS counts no basal insulin. This is software behaviour, not medical advice. Talk to your care team before you change how your pump is driven.

If you discard the Pod, AAPS cannot talk to it anymore. Do this only when all communication with the Pod keeps failing. If AAPS can still talk to the Pod, use Deactivate Pod instead.\n\nIf you go on, remove the Pod from your body.

string.name: dash_error_with_reason
string.comment: %1$s=what failed, %2$s=the reason the driver gave. Example: Failed to resume delivery: No profile active

string.name: dash_overview_connection_quality_value
string.comment: %1$d=connections that worked, %2$d=all connection attempts, %3$.2f=connections that worked in per cent. Example: 95/100 :: 95.00 %

string.name: dash_overview_time_with_time_zone
string.comment: %1$s=date and time on the pod, %2$s=time zone of the pod. Example: 21.10.2026 18:34 (Europe/Paris)

string.name: dash_overview_pdm_notification_value
string.comment: %1$s=title of the PDM message, %2$s=text of the PDM message, %3$s=the PDM reference line. Example: Occlusion Detected (new line) Insulin delivery stopped. Change Pod now. Check your BG (empty line) Ref: 17-00003-02251-020

string.name: dash_pdm_ref
string.comment: %1$s=PDM-style reference code, e.g. 17-01234-05606-020. Shown for support calls, kept in the same format the PDM itself would show.

resources.string: Insulin delivery stopped. Change Pod now.
Insulin delivery stopped. Your PDM and Pod have not communicated in the last 4 hours. To resume insulin delivery, change Pod now.
Insulin delivery stopped. Change Pod now.

Insulin delivery stopped. Change Pod now.

string.name: dash_overview_firmware_version_value
string.comment: %1$s=pod firmware version, %2$s=pod Bluetooth version. Example: Firmware 4.10.0 / Bluetooth 1.3.0

string.name: dash_overview_pod_hard_end_value
string.comment: %1$s=date and time when the pod stops delivering insulin, %2$s=time left until then. Example: 21.10.2026 18:34 (17m remaining)

string.name: dash_overview_uncertain
string.comment: Shown next to a bolus the pod did not confirm yet. Example: 0.50 U (uncertain)

resources.string: Setup in progress (waiting for Pod activation)
Setup in progress (waiting for cannula insertion)
You have not done all steps yet. Do you really want to exit?

Fill a new Pod with enough insulin for 3 days.

Listen for two beeps from the Pod while you fill it. They mean that the minimum of 80 U is in. Empty the fill syringe completely, also after the two beeps.

After filling the Pod, press Next.

Note: do not remove the needle cap of the Pod yet.
Pairing with the new Pod and priming it.\n\nWhen this is done, you can press Next.

Prepare the infusion site. Remove the needle cap and the adhesive backing of the Pod and attach the Pod to the infusion site.

If the cannula sticks out, press Cancel and discard the Pod.

Press Next to insert the cannula and start basal delivery.
When you press OK, the cannula will be inserted. Make sure that the Pod is attached to the infusion site.
Setting the first basal program and inserting the cannula.\n\nWhen the cannula is inserted, you can press Next.

The new Pod is now active.

Your basal program is set and the cannula is inserted.

Check that the cannula is inserted correctly. Change the Pod if you think it is not.
Press Next to deactivate the Pod.\n\nNote: this stops all insulin delivery and deactivates the Pod.
A deactivated Pod cannot be used again. Deactivate this Pod now?
Deactivating the Pod.\n\nWhen this is done, you can press Next.
The Pod is deactivated.\n\nRemove the Pod from your body and recycle it.
The Pod state is discarded. Insulin delivery has NOT been stopped, because the Pod was not deactivated.\n\nRemove the Pod from your body and recycle it.
If you discard the Pod, AAPS cannot talk to it anymore. Do this only when all communication with the Pod keeps failing. Do you really want to discard the Pod?
Setting basal profile might have failed. Delivery might be suspended! Please manually refresh the Pod status on the pump screen and resume delivery if needed.
The stored pod state cannot be read now. This can happen after a restart, before the phone was unlocked. No command is sent to the pod until it is read. Unlock the phone.

string.name: omnipod_dash_ios_pod_fault
string.comment: %1$s=fault code of the pod, three digits, %2$s=fault name. Example: Pod fault: 020 ALARM_OCCLUDED

string.name: omnipod_dash_ios_pod_fault_with_ref
string.comment: %1$s=fault code of the pod, three digits, %2$s=fault name, %3$s=PDM-style reference code. Example: Pod fault: 020 ALARM_OCCLUDED (new line) Ref: 17-00003-02251-020

resources.string: The time zone on the pod is not the time zone of the phone. The basal rate is wrong. Switch the profile to fix it.
The pod did not confirm the suspend of insulin delivery. Refresh the pod status on the pump screen, and resume delivery if needed.

string.name: omnipod_dash_ios_smb_uncertain
string.comment: %1$s=insulin amount with unit. Example: 0.35 U

resources.string: The pod did not confirm the SMB (%1$s). Refresh the pod status to confirm or deny it.
The pod did not confirm the bolus. Refresh the pod status to confirm or deny it.
Setting the temp basal might have failed. If a temp basal was running before, it has been cancelled. Refresh the pod status on the pump screen.
Cancelling the temp basal might have failed. If a temp basal was running before, it might have been cancelled. Refresh the pod status on the pump screen.
The pod did not confirm the cancel of the temp basal
The pod did not confirm the resume of insulin delivery. Refresh the pod status.
Temp basal status is not as expected. If a temp basal was running before, it has been cancelled. Check the insulin delivered and the pod history.

string.name: omnipod_dash_ios_pod_activated

string.name: omnipod_dash_ios_pod_fault_seen
